policyStatus: engineering inventory; the 2026-08-04 public-beta notice adopts enforced lifetimes and active-account/verified-request retention criteria, while complete account lifecycle tooling, jurisdiction-specific legal holds, and external-resource disposition remain explicit limitations

categories: Cloudflare account connection metadata and granted scopes
systems.secrets: OAuth tokens are encrypted; ciphertext, IVs, session token hashes, and credential handles must never be exported
systems.currentRetention: OAuth state expires after 10 minutes, authentication sessions after 30 days, and unreferenced credentials become eligible after 24 hours; 15-minute bounded maintenance can be delayed by backlog or retries; other records remain while the account/service is active or until no longer needed or a verified request is fulfilled, with no inactivity purge
systems.currentExport: no self-service account export exists; users can download individual project source and start a privacy or account-data request through the sanitized public Support form, after which a maintainer may arrange a private method
systems.currentDeletion: no self-service account deletion exists; users can remove individual projects, revoke Cloudflare authorization, and start a deletion request through the sanitized public Support form; deleted D1 state remains provider-recoverable through the current Paid-plan 30-day Time Travel window and must not be intentionally restored after erasure

categories: deployment plans, approvals, status, resources, and errors
systems.secrets: runtime capabilities and Cloudflare access tokens must never be exported
systems.currentRetention: individual chat deletion is soft deletion followed by bounded Agent garbage collection; no account-wide retention schedule exists
systems.currentExport: individual project source can be downloaded; no account-wide export exists
systems.currentDeletion: project removal soft-deletes the chat catalog and asynchronously destroys Agent/workspace state, but chat catalog, transcript, and deployment D1 rows remain; no account-wide user-runtime deletion operation exists; D1 Time Travel recovery can retain deleted state for 7 days on Free or 30 days on Paid and an erasure must be reapplied after any broader recovery

systems.secrets: credentials and access tokens are not transcript export fields
systems.currentRetention: deleted project Agents become eligible for bounded user-runtime garbage collection no earlier than 30 minutes after removal; batch limits, backlog, or retries can delay teardown
systems.currentDeletion: project-scoped garbage collection exists; no account-wide runtime deletion operation or deletion-status result exists

systems.system: ProjectWorkspace Durable Objects and Cloudflare Computer

systems.currentRetention: workspace files persist in the user-owned Durable Object; preview processes and tunnels are bounded by runtime lifecycle
systems.currentDeletion: project-scoped teardown is not exposed as an account-wide operation

systems.system: Cloudflare AI inference and AI Gateway request path
systems.owner: user Cloudflare account; Cloudflare processes inference as the infrastructure provider
categories: prompts and conversation context needed for the request
relevant project files and tool definitions
systems.secrets: Ghostbuild disables AI Gateway request logging at the gateway, model-request, and request-header layers; credentials and capability secrets must never be model inputs
systems.currentRetention: Cloudflare AI transiently processes request content to perform inference under Cloudflare's service controls; when the user selects a partner-labeled model, the listed model provider also transiently processes the content needed for inference; Ghostbuild does not enable AI Gateway request logging and does not use AI Gateway to retain request payloads or request metadata; transcript and project copies remain in their separately inventoried stores
systems.currentExport: there is no AI Gateway log export because request logging is disabled; persisted transcript and project records are subject to the separate incomplete account-export process
systems.currentDeletion: there is no Ghostbuild AI Gateway request log to delete; persisted source records and provider handling remain subject to their separately described controls

systems.system: User-owned workspace runtime and Computer observability
categories: 60%-sampled workspace Worker invocation and diagnostic logs
runtime, project, status, timing, binding, and exception metadata
systems.secrets: prompts, source code, credentials, capability tokens, and raw tool output are not intended log fields and must be excluded from deliberate diagnostic events
systems.currentRetention: logs remain in the connected Cloudflare account under that account's plan, product settings, permissions, and Cloudflare retention controls; Ghostbuild does not copy them into the operator-account log store
systems.currentExport: not included in a Ghostbuild account export; the user controls access through the connected Cloudflare account and its available provider tools
systems.currentDeletion: project or runtime teardown does not immediately erase provider-retained logs; Cloudflare account controls and retention boundaries govern their removal

systems.currentRetention: browser-controlled; pending-prompt and other sessionStorage state lasts until the tab session ends, while OPFS SQLite and localStorage persist until cleared or replaced
systems.currentExport: no server export includes browser-owned data
systems.currentDeletion: users must clear Ghostbuild site data with browser controls; no server-side request can enumerate or erase all browser-owned storage

systems.secrets: deployed bindings and secrets must never be exported by Ghostbuild
systems.currentRetention: resources remain in the user's account until explicitly changed or removed

systems.currentExport: not included in a Ghostbuild account export; the user controls access and any available export through the connected Cloudflare account
systems.currentDeletion: deployment removal does not immediately erase provider-retained observability; the user and Cloudflare account controls govern deletion, and Cloudflare automatically expires retained records at applicable boundaries
